source_render_review: All four actual full-size material source renders previously viewed; current material contact and both HERO images viewed. Original source pixels were viewed individually before modeling.
material_inspection_review: All eight actual images viewed through their labeled contact; independent reviewer additionally viewed all eight individually. Each shows a distinct diagnostic angle, not a new source.
visible_results: Double-pointed concave shell, central vein and branch veins are visible. R04 external tip spikes are absent in R06 observed renders.
The auxiliary rear frame now contains the evidenced second forest direction, instead of the R04 empty background. This does not establish exact forest position or species.
The material HERO and white HERO retain the same composition; white is diagnostic, not a material match.
source_failures: Side outline, center profile, shoulder width and tip positions are not fully source-aligned.
Near oblique left shoulder remains too narrow and pointed compared with the observed broader leaf.
Forest is dark and repetitive, with mismatched species, spacing and height. Shore line remains overly straight.
Water broad color, reflections, bright spot, ripple phase and corner island layout differ. No water color is treated as bathymetry.
coverage_limits: Eight checks cover upper, oblique and near-side leaf geometry, not a clear complete underside inspection.
Dark underside areas and partial forest backgrounds do not validate all mesh intersections or entire shore geometry.
Three primary source-fit hypotheses plus one auxiliary view only. No independent later performance obtained.
white_source_and_checks_review: All four white source renders viewed individually; all eight labeled white checks viewed in their contact. Material/white direct-overlay contacts also viewed. Independent reviewer separately inspects each final image.
supplemental_low_review: Actual DIAG_LOW_09 viewed. Dark partial lower shell silhouette and water are visible. No complete underside, local intersection or buoyancy acceptance.
